note: Next week runs 22 to 29 staff a day across housekeeping and the restaurant, with Friday the tightest: dinner service jumps to 46 covers and we are short two servers, and Henrik's day off leaves no sommelier on the floor. Saturday has its own gap - both VIP-cleared seniors are off together, so Floor 1 goes out with the most experienced attendant acting as lead instead. Wednesday's anniversary party of ten is covered by a senior server briefed on the nut allergy at the table. Most other days run clean, with the usual one or two acting-lead promotions where a senior has a day off. Nothing here is published yet - it is all waiting for your review.
headline: Next week: mostly clean, with a tight Friday dinner and a Saturday VIP-floor gap
